alexa: Quick question — I finalized an adoption last month and need to add my partner's son to benefits. He doesn't have an SSN, he has an ITIN. Is that acceptable for enrollment? Also, we missed open enroll; is this a QLE and can it be added retroactively?

leah (Benefits): Congrats on the adoption! :tada: ITINs are usually fine. For verification we typically need one government ID (passport or national ID) + proof of relationship (adoption decree or finalization papers). For ITIN specifically, the IRS CP565 or ITIN assignment letter helps.

marcos (People Ops): Steps to do this: 1) In HiBob go to Benefits > Add Dependent, 2) attach the adoption decree + ID + ITIN documentation, 3) in the "change reason" pick "Qualified Life Event - adoption" and enter the finalization date. We'll triage once submitted. If you prefer, email benefits@redwood.com with docs and we'll create the request.

alexa: Thanks! Is a scanned ITIN application receipt acceptable if the actual CP565 hasn't arrived yet? Also any translation requirements for foreign docs?

leah (Benefits): Receipt is okay as temporary evidence, but we'll need the official ITIN letter or final decree within 60 days to fully approve. For foreign documents: passport and birth certificates are accepted as-is; court/adoption decrees in a language other than English should include a certified translation.

devin (Payroll): If People Ops approves the QLE, premiums can be applied retroactively to the adoption date as long as we receive completed docs before the payroll cutoff for retro processing. Quick rules: payroll processes deductions on the 2 payroll cycles each month (1st–15th run and 16th–end run). To get a retro adjustment that shows on the next paycheck we need final docs submitted by the 15th for the prior period. If it's after that, the retro will be applied the following cycle. If you want exact dates for your adoption finalization, tell us the date and we can map it to the next payroll window.

alexa: Adoption finalization was 2026-03-08. CP565 expected but might take a few weeks. Will the receipt + decree by next week be enough to start coverage?

marcos (People Ops): Yes — if you submit the HiBob change with the decree + receipt now we'll provisionally add coverage and mark it pending CP565. Benefits team will follow up if anything else is needed. Coverage start date will be the finalization date once approved.

people-ops-bot: Automated: Enrollment change submitted by alexa — status: pending review. Reference ID: ENR-20260308-4521

alexa: Awesome, submitting now. Thank you all! :pray:

leah (Benefits): You're welcome — ping us in thread if you hit any upload issues.

devin (Payroll): If you want me to flag this for expedited retro processing once docs are in, @devin here — I'll watch the submission.

alexa: Will do. Appreciate it! :smile:
